name: Monroe County, MO
findings: Monroe County has 51 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 19 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Monroe County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
67% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Monroe County list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 71% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
